M1a_scale_floor.hypothesis: features with an interquartile range near or at 0 are scaled in raw units or blown up; a fixed floor (anomaly/methods.py SCALE_FLOOR, fixed in protocol version 6) stops ordinary rounding looking as unusual as a problem

M1b_drop_fed_rate.change: leave out one at a time, each a candidate - fed_rate, fed_vs_own, fed_vs_peers, fed_rate_vs_last_term, uptake, enrolment_change
